privacyRejectMessage: We regret to inform you that we cannot continue with the process, as you have not accepted our Privacy Notice. This document is essential to ensure your safety and protect your personal data. If you have any questions or concerns about the terms provided, please do not hesitate to contact our support team. We are here to help you better understand our policies and clarify any doubts you may have. Thank you for your understanding.
fastingMessage: Thank you for your interest in taking the Preventix test. To ensure the accuracy of the results, it is essential to comply with the required fasting time before sample collection. Fasting helps obtain more accurate measurements of certain markers in your body, ensuring more reliable results. If you have not complied with the required fasting period, we urge you to contact our phlebotomist for guidance on the next steps. The phlebotomist will be happy to provide you with information on how to proceed correctly. We understand that fasting can be inconvenient, but it is crucial to ensure accurate and useful results for your health. If you have any additional questions or need more details about the process, please do not hesitate to contact our support team.
